Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 5, 2026

NUR ("we", "our", "the app") is a free Islamic companion app. This policy explains what information the app uses, where it is stored, and who it is shared with.

1. The short version

  • NUR works without an account. There is no sign-up and no sign-in.
  • Your settings, location and activity are stored only on your device. We do not receive them.
  • There are no ads, no analytics, no tracking across apps, and we never sell data.

2. Information stored on your device

To work, NUR keeps the following on your phone only:

  • Preferences: your tradition, madhab, prayer calculation method, language, theme, Hijri date adjustment and notification settings.
  • Location: the name of your city and your coordinates rounded to about 1 km. Precise GPS readings are used in memory to calculate prayer times and the Qiblah direction and are not saved.
  • Activity: your prayer log and streaks, tasbeeh counts, bookmarks, and the values you enter in the Zakat calculator.

Deleting the app removes all of this data. Because there is no account, we hold no copy of it.

3. Location

NUR asks for location permission so it can calculate prayer times and the Qiblah direction. These calculations happen entirely on your device using the open-source adhan library. If you prefer not to share your location, you can search for your city by name instead.

To show your city's name, the app uses your phone's built-in place-name lookup (provided by Apple on iPhone and Google on Android), which receives your coordinates under that company's privacy policy. When you search for a city by name, the text you type is sent to the Open-Meteo geocoding service. When you tap "Masjids near you" or "Halal food near you", NUR opens your maps app with that search and your approximate location; the maps app handles it under its own privacy policy.

4. Content services the app connects to

NUR downloads religious content and reference data from the services below. These requests do not include your name, location or any account information, but, as with any internet request, the service can see your device's IP address and basic technical details such as the app's network headers.

  • AlQuran.Cloud (api.alquran.cloud, cdn.islamic.network): Quran text, translations and recitation audio.
  • Hadith API by fawazahmed0, served through the jsDelivr CDN: Sunni hadith collections.
  • ThaqalaynAPI (thaqalayn-api.net): Shia hadith collections.
  • Supabase: hosts NUR's library of scholar quotes, which the app reads without sending any personal data.
  • Gold-API (gold-api.com): current gold and silver prices for the Zakat calculator.
  • Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com): city search, only when you search for a city by name.

5. Notifications

Prayer time notifications are scheduled on your device by your phone's operating system. No notification data passes through our servers.

6. Reporting inaccurate content

When you report a hadith, quote or other content as inaccurate, NUR opens your email app with a pre-filled message to us. We only receive what you choose to send, including your email address. We use reports only to review and correct content, and delete them once they are resolved.

7. Children

NUR is not directed at children under 13 and does not knowingly collect personal information from anyone.

8. Your choices

  • You can turn location and notification permissions on or off at any time in your device settings.
  • You can change or clear your city in Settings → Location.
  • You can delete all of NUR's data by deleting the app.

9. Changes to this policy

If NUR's data practices change, for example if optional accounts are added, we will update this policy and the date above before the change takes effect.
